senses.gloss: (b. h. הָפַךְ q. v.)to turn, change, reverse, overthrow.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 2:3">Kil. II, 3</cite> say not I will plant <he>ואח״כ אוֹפַךְ</he> and then turn the soil over (destroy the previous seed) <he>אלא אוֹפֵךְ</he> Ar. (ed. <he>הוֹפֵךְ</he>) but one must first uproot &c. (cmp. <cite ref="A00642"><he>אוכל</he></cite> fr. <cite ref="A01696"><he>אָכַל</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Mishnah Terumot 9:1">Ter. IX, 1</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Kilaim 1:16">Tosef. Kil. I, 16</cite> <he>יוֹפַךְ</he> he shall &c.
<cite ref="Tosefta Kilaim 1:16">Ib.</cite> end <he>לייפך</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>לוֹפַךְ</he>) to uproot.
